label: 6. I'd like to give a report on

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I'd like to give a report on

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Matis's recent activities.
Right now?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: If we're left to our own devices,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: we inevitably end up slacking on our reports.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Even I've forgotten about it a handful of times.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: So I thought it might be better

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: if we made our reports with you present, hehe.
I see.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Can we hurry this up?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I've got a villain's meeting arranged for us all right after this.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Okay okay.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Laplace, are you ready?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: A hero is always ready!

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Please summarize the activities

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: you've conducted over the past week and share them with us.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I'll start.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Day 1: Conducted experiments with Cutey, with the expectance of increased firepower.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Day 2: Continued experiments, contemplating further exploration.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Day 3: Conducted firepower tests on the surface with Cutey, achieved a new record.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: All you did was conduct experiments with Birdie.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: How unbecoming of a hero!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: What a useless report.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: You'll never become a proper villain at that rate.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: This is a perfectly ordinary report!

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: You guys share your reports, then.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I'll tell you about my stupendous villainous activities.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I noticed an empty can,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I decided to use it as a projectile and totally jack up the garbage can.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: So I picked it up and threw it with all my might.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: It landed right inside the garbage can! You should have heard the sound it made.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: What do you think about that?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: All you did was pick up some garbage. That's a noble and heroic act.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: But wait, there's more!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: There was a pesky little brat,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: and I popped some candy in his mouth that made a nice crackling sound when he ate it.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: You should have seen his expression!

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: That was a kind thing you did for that child.
Very much so.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I think we've got the gist of Drake's report.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Okay, Laplace, your turn.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Prepare to be blown away.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Day 1: I had a great day as a hero.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Day 2: I was even more heroic than yesterday.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Day 3: I was even more heroic than yesterday and the day before.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Day 4: I was more heroic than any other day!

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Hmm...
I think this will be the last time I sit in for one of these sessions.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Hahaha.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I think so too.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: At any rate,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: let's just do the best we can in our respective positions.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Understood!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Then I shall begin my heroic patrol.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: And I'm about to go commit some villainous deeds.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: As for me,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I'm going to rest.
Best of luck, everyone.
